book_intro:
Blue Letter Bible bakanlığı ve BLB Enstitüsü, Kutsal Yazıların tahrif edilemezliğine olan kesin inancı da içeren tarihsel, muhafazakar Hristiyan inancına bağlıdır. BLB tarafından sağlanan metin ve ses içeriği çeşitli Evanjelik gelenekleri temsil ettiğinden, kaynak materyallerde aktarılan tüm fikir ve ilkelerin bu bakanlık tarafından toplamda onaylanması gerekmez.

Blue Letter Kutsal Kitap çalışma araçları Kutsal Kitap'ı okumayı, araştırmayı ve çalışmayı kolay ve ödüllendirici hale getirir.

notes.text: a seah of fine flour . . . two seahs of barley. A seah is about 7 quarts (7.7 liters). Rescue is coming, and normal business at the gate of Samaria will be resumed on the following day (the prices are much lower here than in 6:25).

windows in heaven. This officer cannot imagine how such an economic recovery could happen overnight. Will God hand out material blessings (see Mal. 3:10)? To mock the prophetic word is to mock the Lord himself, however, so he shall see it . . . but . . . not eat.
four men who were lepers. Faced with certain death if they enter the city or sit where they are, they instead choose possible death in the camp of the Syrians.
the people trampled him. The skeptical officer of v. 2 is trampled in the scramble to take the Syrians’ supplies, fulfilling Elisha’s prophecy.
